coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies in residential dwelling units. The text states no unit-count, building-age, construction-date or owner-based exemptions.
coverage.other_conditions: Residential tenants and residential dwelling units only.

evidence.quoted_span: given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter
given in writing by a landlord to a residential tenant pursuant to this chapter
in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit

result.notes: I removed 'Nonpayment-of-rent notices only' from other_conditions. It describes the triggering landlord act (serving a notice to quit for nonpayment), not which buildings, units or owners are covered, and that trigger is already captured in the requirement. The only scope limit in § 31 is residential tenants and dwelling units. The statute states no unit-count, age, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size conditions, so all of those fields stay null. No preemption or local-yield language appears, and the Boston and Cambridge local notices mentioned in the review note are not in these documents.
